calls.summary: Danielle Whitfield called to open a Truist One Checking account after switching from another bank. Agent Oscar walked her through the direct-deposit fee waiver and booked a branch appointment to finalize the paperwork. She left satisfied with a confirmed time.

Marcus Deleon asked about current mortgage rates for a first home purchase. Agent Lila reviewed the Homebuyer's Guide options and scheduled a consultation with a loan officer. He appreciated the clear next steps.

Priya Nandakumar wanted to compare the Truist Enjoy Cash credit card tiers before applying. Agent Rosey explained the 3%, 2%, 1% rewards and the 12 month intro APR, then set an in-branch appointment to complete the application. She confirmed the meeting gladly.

New caller Anthony Brubaker phoned to open his first checking and savings relationship and asked how to get started. Agent Lee collected his full name, address, and employment details, then scheduled a new-account appointment at the nearest branch. Anthony confirmed the time and thanked Lee for the help.

Gloria Sandoval called about the latest Truist CD rates for a 12 month term. Agent Mary confirmed the current APY and minimum deposit, then booked an appointment to fund the certificate. Gloria was pleased with the guaranteed rate.

Ramon Castellano wanted to refinance an existing auto loan to lower his monthly payment. Agent Sue reviewed refinance terms and scheduled a follow-up appointment with a lending specialist. He agreed the estimate looked promising.

Teresa Okoro asked about a HELOC to fund a kitchen remodel. Agent Mike explained the draw period and variable rate but she wanted to think it over before committing. No appointment was booked on this call.

Bradley Kimura disputed a late fee on his Truist Enjoy Cash credit card statement. Agent Jennifer opened a review case and explained the dispute timeline. He remained frustrated that a credit had not posted yet.
Nadia Fuller called because a Zelle transfer had not reached her recipient. Agent Rose checked the transaction status and started a trace request. Nadia was anxious about the missing funds.
Victor Aldridge checked the status of his pending auto loan application. Agent Oscar found that a document was still missing and requested a re-upload. Victor was annoyed at the delay.

Sharon Vandermeer wanted to cancel her Truist One Money Market account after a fee surprise. Agent Lila explained the waiver conditions but Sharon insisted on closing it. The cancellation request was logged.
Curtis Mbeki complained that a Zelle limit blocked an urgent payment and no one had called him back. Agent Mary apologized and escalated to the fraud team. He stayed upset about the wait time.

Elena Poborsky left a voicemail asking about the status of her HELOC application and closing costs. The call rolled to voicemail after hours with no agent available. Her message was flagged for a callback.
Gerald Tomlinson was furious about an escrow error on his mortgage statement. Agent Mike tried to explain the adjustment but Gerald demanded a supervisor. The call ended without resolution.

Bianca Shreveport complained that her Truist One Checking overdraft cushion had not worked as promised and she was charged twice. Agent Jennifer opened a complaint ticket but could not reverse the fees on the call. Bianca remained dissatisfied.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: Yes. The caller is relocating to the Charlotte area and needs to open a new checking account with a bank that has local branch access and no monthly fees. They are switching from another bank and want to get set up before their move.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: The caller expects a straightforward process to open an account, wants confirmation of an in-person appointment at a nearby branch, and is interested in learning about rewards credit card options during the appointment.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: The agent should have captured the caller's email address for account opening confirmation and appointment reminders. Additionally, the agent could have set clearer expectations about what documents to bring to the appointment and confirmed that a welcome package would be sent to their new address.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Truist. This is Marcus Bell. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus. I'm looking to open a checking account. I'm moving to Charlotte in about two weeks and I need to set up banking there.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's great. I'd be happy to help you open an account with Truist. To get started, can I get your full name please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure. It's David Chen.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, David. And just to confirm, you're looking to open a checking account as a new customer with us?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. I've heard good things about Truist and I like that there are branches all over Charlotte.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. We have great branch availability in Charlotte. What's the ZIP code where you'll be living?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: 28202. That's in the uptown area.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent. We definitely service that area. Now David, are you interested in our Truist One Checking account? It's our flagship checking product with no monthly fees when you set up direct deposit, and it comes with some nice overdraft protection options.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That sounds good. No monthly fees is definitely what I want. Do you have any rewards credit cards?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: We absolutely do. We have several options including our Enjoy Cash Visa card with cash back rewards. We can discuss all the details at your appointment, and you can apply if you're interested. Let me schedule that appointment for you now. How does Thursday, October 26th at 2 PM sound at our Uptown Charlotte location?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That works perfectly for me.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great, David. So I've got you scheduled for Thursday, October 26th at 2 PM at our Uptown branch. A specialist will walk you through the account opening process and we can explore credit card options. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: No, that covers it. Thanks for your help, Marcus.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome, David. Thank you for choosing Truist and we look forward to seeing you on the 26th. Have a great day.

callDetail.aiSummary: David Chen, a new banking customer relocating to Charlotte, called to open a checking account with Truist. Marcus Bell successfully captured David's full name, confirmed service area availability in ZIP code 28202, and discussed the features of the Truist One Checking account including no monthly fees. An in-person appointment was scheduled for October 26th at the Uptown Charlotte location where David can complete his account opening and explore rewards credit card options. The agent offered the Enjoy Cash Visa as a credit product opportunity but did not capture David's email address for confirmation or collect additional documentation requirements.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus Great call structure and product knowledge on the Truist One Checking pitch. You clearly qualified David's need and moved through the appointment booking smoothly. Two coaching points: make sure you always capture the email address for account confirmation and appointment reminders, especially on new customer intakes. Also, set expectations upfront about what documents David should bring to his appointment (ID, proof of address, etc.). This removes friction and improves the check-in experience. Well done overall.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Truist, this is Marcus. Who do I have the pleasure of speaking with today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus, my name is Danielle Foster. I just moved to the area and I'm looking to open a new checking account.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Welcome to Truist, Danielle, and congratulations on the move. Are you brand new to Truist, or have you banked with us before?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Brand new. I've never had an account here. I've been with a smaller local bank up until now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great, I can absolutely help you get set up. May I ask what matters most to you in a checking account, things like direct deposit, mobile banking, or avoiding fees?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Honestly, avoiding fees is a big one. What does the monthly charge run on your everyday account? I want to keep it manageable.
highlights: What does the monthly charge run

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's a fair question. Our Truist One Checking has a twelve dollar monthly maintenance fee, but it's waived when you set up a qualifying direct deposit or keep a minimum balance. Most customers never pay it.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Okay, that's reasonable. The bank down the street offered me free checking with no strings, so I'm comparing a few options before I decide.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That makes sense, and I'd encourage you to compare. What sets Truist One apart is the overdraft cushion tiers and relationship benefits, plus your direct deposit waives the fee entirely, so it functions like free checking with more protection.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That's good to know. I'd also want to look at a rewards credit card at some point. Do you have anything with cash back?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: We do. The Truist Enjoy Cash Visa has no annual fee and earns three, two, and one percent cash rewards in your top categories, with a low intro APR for the first twelve months. It pairs nicely with the checking account.
highlights: three, two, and one percent cash rewards

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Nice. One thing though, I don't want to be locked into anything if it turns out this isn't the right fit for me.
highlights: don't want to be locked into anything

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Completely understand, and there's no lock-in. The checking account has no term commitment, and the card is a standard revolving account you can manage or close anytime. You're always in control.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That eases my mind. I think I'd like to come in and get this started properly with someone.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. I can schedule an appointment at your nearest branch so a banker walks you through the checking account and the Enjoy Cash card together. Would Thursday at 10 AM work?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thursday at 10 works for me. Let me just double-check with my husband, but I'm fairly sure we're free then.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No problem at all. I'll pencil in Thursday at 10 AM and send a confirmation. What's the best email and phone number to reach you?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Email is danielle.foster@email.com, and my cell is 704-555-0182.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect, you're all set for Thursday at 10 AM, Danielle. Bring a photo ID and we'll have everything ready. Thank you for choosing Truist, and welcome to the family.
highlights: all set for Thursday at 10 AM

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thank you so much, Marcus. See you Thursday.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Take care, Danielle. Goodbye.

brandConversationRules: Intro + offer: Introduce yourself as Truist's AI banking assistant here to help match you with the right account or loan and set up a personalized banking consultation, mention that new Truist One Checking clients may qualify for a limited-time welcome bonus with qualifying direct deposit, and ask if they'd like to get started.

Qualify one question at a time: Ask only one question per text, covering which product they're interested in (checking, savings, credit card, mortgage, auto or personal loan), their primary banking goal, their approximate timeline to open or apply, whether they're a current Truist client, and finally their ZIP code so we can confirm the nearest branch.

Confirm then book: Confirm we have a Truist branch near their ZIP, share a general overview of the options that fit their goal without quoting exact rates or fees, recommend a consultation with a Truist banker for personalized terms, propose a specific day and time, and confirm they'll receive a reminder text before the appointment with a number to call.

qaPairs.question: What is the monthly fee for Truist One Checking?
qaPairs.answer: Truist One Checking has a monthly maintenance fee that can be waived when you meet relationship or direct deposit requirements. I can set you up with a banker who will walk through the exact ways to waive it and help you open the account.

qaPairs.question: How do I open a Truist checking account?
qaPairs.answer: You can open a Truist One, Confidence, or Student Checking account online or with a banker at your local branch. I'd be glad to book a quick appointment so a banker can help you choose the right fit and complete the setup.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer a no fee student checking account?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Truist Student Checking has no monthly maintenance fee for enrolled students and includes our digital banking tools. Let's schedule a short appointment so a banker can get you started.

qaPairs.question: What are your current CD rates?
qaPairs.answer: Our Certificates of Deposit come in terms from 7 months to 5 years with fixed, guaranteed rates that change over time. A banker can share today's current terms and help you open one during a consultation.

qaPairs.question: Which credit card gives the best cash rewards?
qaPairs.answer: The Truist Enjoy Cash Visa offers tiered cash rewards with no annual fee, which many clients love. I can arrange a consultation so a banker can compare it with our other cards for your spending habits.

qaPairs.question: Do you have a card for building credit?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, the Truist Enjoy Cash Secured Visa helps you build credit while earning cash rewards. Let's set up an appointment so a banker can review the deposit requirement and get you approved.

qaPairs.question: Can I refinance my auto loan with Truist?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we offer auto refinancing that may lower your rate or payment depending on your situation. A banker can review your details during a consultation to find the best terms for you.

qaPairs.question: What personal loans do you offer?
qaPairs.answer: Through LightStream we offer fixed-rate personal loans for debt consolidation, home improvement, and major expenses with no fees and no collateral. I'd be happy to book a consultation so a specialist can review your options.

qaPairs.question: How much can I borrow with a HELOC?
qaPairs.answer: Your available amount depends on your home equity, credit, and other factors that a lending specialist reviews individually. Let's schedule an appointment so a banker can walk you through the numbers.

qaPairs.question: What mortgage programs are available?
qaPairs.answer: Truist offers purchase, refinance, FHA, VA, doctor, and construction-to-permanent home loans among others. A mortgage consultation is the best way to match a program to your goals, and I can set that up for you.

qaPairs.question: Do you have a branch near me?
qaPairs.answer: We have branches across our service footprint, and I can confirm the closest one once you share your ZIP code. From there I'll book you an appointment with a nearby banker.

qaPairs.question: How do I switch my banking to Truist?
qaPairs.answer: Our team can help you move direct deposits and automatic payments smoothly using our switching guide. Let's set up an appointment so a banker can walk you through each step.

qaPairs.question: Does Truist offer Zelle and mobile banking?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Truist includes Zelle, Paze, and full online and mobile banking with our accounts. A banker can help you enroll and get comfortable with the tools during a quick appointment.

qaPairs.question: What is the difference between Truist One Savings and the Money Market account?
qaPairs.answer: Truist One Savings is a companion savings account with automatic-transfer tools, while the One Money Market Account is designed for higher balances with check and debit access. A banker can help you pick the right one during a consultation.

qaPairs.question: Can I open a savings account for my child?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we offer savings options that work well for building early habits, and a banker can review the best fit for your family. I'd be glad to schedule an appointment for you.

qaPairs.question: How do I apply for a mortgage refinance?
qaPairs.answer: You can start a refinance with a mortgage specialist who reviews your current loan and goals to find savings opportunities. Let me book a consultation so we can get that started.

qaPairs.question: What do I need to open an account?
qaPairs.answer: Generally you'll need a government-issued ID, your Social Security number, and a way to fund the account, though a banker will confirm specifics for your situation. Let's set up an appointment so everything is ready.

qaPairs.question: Do you finance RVs and boats?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we offer recreational loans for RVs, boats, marine, and motorcycles at fixed terms. A banker can review your financing options during a consultation, and I can book that now.

qaPairs.question: Can I invest through Truist?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Truist Trade offers self-directed investing with commission-free online stock and ETF trades, plus advisor-guided planning is available. A consultation with a specialist is a great next step, and I can arrange it.

qaPairs.question: How do I get pre-qualified without hurting my credit?
qaPairs.answer: We offer a way to check for offers you may pre-qualify for without impacting your credit score. Let's schedule an appointment so a banker can walk you through your personalized options.

signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["what are your CD rates today (Caller)", "seven month certificate of deposit (Agent)", "how much APY on a one year CD (Caller)", "thousand dollar minimum to open a CD (Agent)"])

signals.name: Competitor Rate Mentioned
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["Bank of America is offering me a better rate (Caller)", "Wells Fargo has no monthly fee (Caller)", "Chase gave me a higher APY (Caller)", "I'm comparing you to Ally (Caller)"])

signals.name: Fee Objection Raised
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["I don't want a twelve dollar monthly fee (Caller)", "how do I waive the maintenance fee (Caller)", "why am I getting an overdraft charge (Caller)", "is there a no fee checking option (Caller)"])

signals.name: Quote Provided
signals.rules: voice_signal = any(1, ["your estimated APR would be around (Agent)", "your monthly mortgage payment comes to (Agent)", "here is the rate I can offer on the auto loan (Agent)", "your HELOC line would be approximately (Agent)"])
